Note that all statements following the header line are indented. We initialize it with an empty dictionary by setting it to a pair of braces {}.

We need dictionary to store key-value pairs where each key represents a character and the value that is mapped to that key represents the list of words starting with that character. [[LINE07.EXPL1]] We need to split the given string into words and store the words in a list. [[LINE07.EXPL2]] We use split() function with no arguments because we want the split function to separate strings using space character.
